meta.subject: shared memory rd/wr race condition fix

en.summary: This commit fixes a shared-memory bank collision bug by removing the SRAM setting that disabled read/write checking on same-address accesses.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly describes a shared-memory read/write race fix.
Only the DUT shared-memory file is changed.
The patch changes real bank collision semantics in the backing SRAM primitive.
evidence: The per-bank VX_sp_ram instance no longer passes NO_RWCHECK(1).
Those bank RAM instances directly implement the visible load/store behavior of shared memory.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A banked scratchpad or shared-memory design must define what happens when a read and a write hit the same bank entry in the same cycle. If the SRAM is configured to skip collision checking or bypass handling, the load can observe stale, undefined, or implementation-dependent data instead of the architecturally expected value.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A load and a store target the same shared-memory bank entry in the same cycle or pipeline window handled by one SRAM primitive.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Force the bank memory primitive into a mode that does not guarantee correct read-during-write behavior.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: disable SRAM read/write collision check or bypass
portability_notes: Map this to any scratchpad, shared-memory, or local-memory bank built from a single-port RAM with implicit read-during-write semantics.
The fault does not require changing arbitration if the design already allows a same-bank collision to reach the SRAM.
If the target DUT already serializes same-bank conflicts before the RAM, this bug should instead be injected at the arbitration point that wrongly permits a racing access.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the per-bank RAM primitive that stores shared-memory words.
Enable a no-read/write-check or undefined read-during-write mode, or remove the existing bypass logic that makes same-address collisions deterministic.
Keep bank scheduling unchanged so the faulty SRAM semantics are observable on real collisions.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix removes NO_RWCHECK(1) from each VX_sp_ram bank instance so same-address read/write collisions are no longer allowed to race silently.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Re-add NO_RWCHECK(1) on the VX_sp_ram instances in the shared-memory bank generation loop.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: A same-bank load/store collision can return stale or nondeterministic data, causing incorrect shared-memory reads.
evidence_for_injection: The entire patch is a one-line parameter change on the bank RAM primitive.
No test-only or software-only logic is involved; the changed primitive sits directly on the shared-memory data path.
notes: This is a localized mutation and is easy to port to other banked scratchpad designs.

zh.summary: 该提交通过去掉会关闭同地址读写检查的 SRAM 设置，修复了 shared memory bank 冲突缺陷。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明是在修复 shared memory 读写竞争。
只改动了 DUT 的 shared-memory 文件。
补丁直接改变了底层 SRAM 原语对 bank 冲突的真实语义。
evidence: 每个 bank 的 VX_sp_ram 实例不再传入 NO_RWCHECK(1)。
这些 bank RAM 实例直接决定 shared memory 对 load/store 的可见行为。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: banked scratchpad 或 shared memory 设计必须定义：当同一个周期里读和写命中同一个 bank 条目时应返回什么数据。如果 SRAM 被配置成跳过冲突检查或旁路处理，那么 load 看到的就可能是过期值、未定义值或实现相关值，而不是体系结构期望的结果。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一个 load 和一个 store 在同一周期或同一 SRAM 处理窗口内命中同一个 shared-memory bank 条目。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把 bank 存储原语强制成不保证读写冲突正确性的模式。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: disable SRAM read/write collision check or bypass
portability_notes: 可映射到任何由单端口 RAM 构成、且读写同周期语义隐含在原语中的 scratchpad、shared memory 或 local memory bank。
如果设计本身已经允许同 bank 冲突到达 SRAM，就不需要改动仲裁。
如果目标 DUT 在到达 RAM 前就串行化了同 bank 冲突，那么应把故障注入到错误放行竞争访问的仲裁点。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到存放 shared-memory 数据的每个 bank RAM 原语。
开启 no-read/write-check 或未定义 read-during-write 模式，或移除已有的旁路逻辑，使同地址冲突再次变成不确定行为。
保持 bank 调度不变，这样真实冲突时就能观测到错误的 SRAM 语义。

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复从每个 VX_sp_ram bank 实例上移除了 NO_RWCHECK(1)，不再允许同地址读写冲突静默竞争。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 shared-memory bank 生成循环里的 VX_sp_ram 实例上重新加入 NO_RWCHECK(1)。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 同 bank 的 load/store 冲突会再次返回过期或不确定的数据，导致 shared-memory 读取错误。
evidence_for_injection: 整个补丁本质上就是 bank RAM 原语上的一处参数修改。
没有测试或软件层逻辑参与；被修改的原语就在 shared-memory 数据路径上。
notes: 这是一个局部变异，移植到其他 banked scratchpad 设计也比较直接。
